reason: An MCP server management plugin for the DeepSeek Harness Web settings page, providing runtime server lifecycle controls, live status, tool inspection, reconnect behavior, and configuration synchronization; its stdio support can execute configured commands.

summaries.zh: 在 DeepSeek Harness 设置页管理 MCP 服务器，支持运行时添加、编辑、启停、重连、删除、状态查看和工具检查。
summaries.en: Manage MCP servers from the DeepSeek Harness settings page with runtime lifecycle controls, live status, reconnection, configuration synchronization, and tool inspection.

capabilities: Adds, edits, enables, disables, reconnects, and deletes MCP server configurations
Opens runtime connections to streamable HTTP and stdio MCP servers
Registers tools exposed by connected MCP servers for sessions
Watches and hot-syncs a local MCP configuration file
Provides a web settings interface and HTTP API
